extraction.Name: Charles Deroin
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Land was sold to John Knox for $4000 but when deed signed to Knox, he gave allottee $10 applied bal. to debts
extraction.Buyer: John Knox for $4000 (allottee received $10 at signing; balance applied to debts); Knox now residing in Calif.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Has any of the land been sold for debt or taxes? no
extraction.Occupation/Income: $57.50 War Risk Insurance, received each month. Has small inherited interest. No contributions.
extraction.NOTES: Good health, no property or money accumulated. Two minor children dependent upon allottee. Allottee feels he was defrauded of his land, as he did not owe anything like $4000 to John Knox. $4000 was stated as a good price for the land but allottee says he did not owe Mr. Knox the amount Knox claimed. Date of receipt: Nov. 1928. Questionnaire executed November 22, 1928 before notary in Kay County, Oklahoma. Commission expires Aug. 3rd (year not stated). Notary public, Ponca City, Okla.
